page_text_ocr_zh:
1
在农场一个泥泞的小池子旁边，一只不幸的鸭子正在发愁。
“我的嘎嘎声叫不出来了，我要去把它找回来。”
于是这只不幸的鸭子啪嗒啪嗒走到水边，跳进小池子，潜下去找啊找。
page_text_en:
1
By a muddy little pond on the farm, an unlucky duck was worrying.
"My quacking sound can't come out anymore. I need to go find it."
So this unlucky duck paddled over to the water's edge, jumped into the little pond, and dived down to look and look.
summary_zh: 一只不幸的鸭子在农场的小池子旁发愁，因为它的嘎嘎声消失了，于是它跳进池子潜下去寻找自己的声音。

page_text_ocr_zh: 可是哪儿也找不到这嘎嘎声。
page_text_en: But he couldn't find his quacking sound anywhere.
summary_zh: 蓝色的鸭子在池塘边焦急地寻找自己的嘎嘎声，但一无所获。

在农场一个滑嗒嗒湿漉漉的肥料堆上，这只不幸的鸭子咯咯叫着。
两只母鸡说：“鸭子是不咯咯叫的。”
“可是我的嘎嘎声不见了，你们能帮我把它找回来吗？”
于是，这一只不幸的鸭子和两只爱帮忙的母鸡在鸡棚里找啊找。
page_text_en:

On a slippery, wet pile of fertilizer in the farmyard, this unlucky duck was quacking.
Two hens said, “Ducks don’t quack.”
“But my quacking sound is gone. Can you help me find it?”
So, this unlucky duck and two helpful hens searched and searched in the henhouse.
summary_zh: 不幸的鸭子在农场的肥料堆上发出咯咯声，两只母鸡指出鸭子不该这样叫，鸭子请求它们帮忙找回自己的嘎嘎声，于是它们一起在鸡棚里寻找。

In the muddy little pond on the farm, ten spotted ducks quacked: "Stop it! We can't find a better quack than ours anymore!"
So, ten spotted ducks,
 nine clever cows,
 eight bouncy goats,
 seven fluffy sheep,
 six chattering geese,
 five lively horses,
 four clever cats,
 three sleepy dogs,
 and two helpful hens all together……
